spiritgiven.comments:
Thank you for a clean and spirited game! Even there were language barriers, you talked slowly and clearly for us so that we could understand. We really appreciate the work you made to communicate with us. 
Wish you good luck!
Communication changed  to 3 per Japan request by spirit director
Body contact was improved in the latter half. Communicated well. Thank you for a spirited game!
Most of the game went well and we appreciate it. but a player bumped in to one of us and made her fell and didn't care for her.

spiritreceived.comments: We thought there was good communication throughout despite the language barrier. The translator was used really well.

Arigato Nippon for such a beautiful game! We loved your positivity and the gracefulness of call resolution. We really appreciated the low contact game and the good communication throughout the match. Good luck for the rest of the tournament!

Many calls were contested very quickly and the discussions were not fruitful. Several calls were maintained even when our players tried to explain a different perspective. Sideline became involved in the calls on a few occasions without being asked to. These points were brought up with the spirit captain at halftime however the adjustment was not made. We recognize the language barrier and the long discussions were not a factor in this score.

Thank you for an incredibly enjoyable and spirited game.
We appreciate the love hearts and joining into our Aussie cheers!
You always maintained positivity, even if you were behind on the scoreboard.

Arigato Nippon for an even better game today. We thought your spirit was so clean in every category, but your positivity was truly exceptional. It felt like we were playing with you rather than against you, and we want to thank you so much for the beautiful energy. This is what ultimate is all about! Tēnā rawa atu koe, ngā mihi nui.
Thank you so much for such a great game and tournament!! Congratulations on bronze!!!!
